## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy` and `cargo test --workspace` were run
      and their real output is above.
- [ ] CI was checked with `gh run list` (or
      `gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits/{sha}/check-runs`). If check-runs was
      used, the **set of expected job names** was asserted — a workflow that
      dies at startup produces no check-runs at all, so "nothing failed" is also
      true of nothing having run.
- [ ] No JavaScript or TypeScript is shipped or served, and no `<script>` tag
      appears in any response.
- [ ] Any new route was added to **both** script-free sweeps.
- [ ] `_Sidebar.md` was not hand-edited — it is generated by
      `berrywiki sidebar <folder> --write`.
- [ ] Documentation added here claims nothing unmeasured: no release that has
      not been tagged, no GitHub Wiki behaviour the spikes have not verified, no
      accessibility property beyond the structural gate.
